title: Give your agent a character
description: Choose an included candy avatar or create your own. Keep its editable SVG in the agent folder, with a preview before saving.

title: See what changed. Go back.
description: Bring the host's Git snapshots into the browser. Inspect a run's changes and review a restore before applying it.

title: Pair another device
description: Open your agents on another device with a QR code and its own token. Keep the host private by default.
